parsed.rationale: Both participating records are entry-point `body` computed properties for standalone SwiftUI preview/sample applications (`WXUISampleApp` in `Shared/WXUI/Examples/WXUISampleApp/Sources/WXUISampleApp.swift` and `PlayerHeaderViewApp` in `Shared/PlayerHeaderView/PlayerHeaderViewApp/PlayerHeaderViewApp.swift`). Although `is_sample_app` is reported as `false` in the context flags, the file paths place both files squarely inside per-package app-runner directories (`Examples/WXUISampleApp` and `PlayerHeaderViewApp`), which are canonical sample/preview harness locations in this repo. A trivial `var body: some Scene` that launches a single-window app is structurally identical across every SwiftUI app entry point by design; the coincidence is architectural boilerplate, not accidental duplication. Extracting or sharing this property would couple two otherwise independent packages for no meaningful gain.
